Use task01 parsed native paths and RO handles. Read ChainState at the exact LastFinalizedBlock key for H; retain Execution E, Finish, CE Q, projection P and closure C separately. Metadata(storage_settings) absent selects supported legacy v1; malformed present JSON is corruption. Recognize incomplete/unwind state explicitly and do not recover it offline. Specifically inspect partial_state_trie and unwind progress: pinned Reth can persist Finish with account/storage updates masked by a later suffix. Require a complete current-state image for root success. A mixed/partial image is Incomplete under this algorithm; neither raw Finish nor the smaller partial frontier alone is a valid substitute. Normal graceful head persistence uses equal complete frontiers; do not modify shutdown or invoke source recovery.

Header traversal is over actual retained canonical intervals, not a mandatory genesis-to-E chain. Discover segment bounds from native static-file metadata; stream every retained header, require number correctness, recompute native OutbeHeader hash, compare canonical hash/index records and join consecutive parent hashes across contiguous segment boundaries. Record retention boundaries/gaps. A missing interior record in an advertised interval is corruption; an unavailable requested header outside retention is incomplete. Check configured genesis/network against available native identity records separately; do not invent a genesis traversal requirement or an independent consensus-finality proof.

Implement read_header_ce_commitment with existing outbe_primitives::reshare_artifact::decode_outbe_block_artifacts(&header.extra_data), take compressed_entities_root and require supported scheme plus exact marker Q/hash/root when applicable. The decoder already validates magic/version/tag/length/duplicates/trailing bytes. Empty extra_data is not a present CE commitment. Genesis uses the native sealed_root(ZERO) initialization rule as a separate case.

Create a fresh writable scratch MDBX outside every source/protected/output root. Source opens only with open_db_read_only and StaticFileProviderBuilder::read_only. Read v1 PlainAccountState completely, keccak addresses into scratch HashedAccounts; read every PlainStorageState duplicate, keccak address and slot into scratch HashedStorages. For v2 copy authoritative HashedAccounts/HashedStorages unchanged, never double-hash and never require populated plain tables. Decode native rows, reject malformed/duplicate/orphan storage representation rather than silently discarding it.

Keep scratch AccountsTrie/StoragesTrie empty. Use reth_trie_db::DatabaseStateRoot::from_tx on StateRoot<DatabaseTrieCursorFactory<_,LegacyKeyAdapter>,DatabaseHashedCursorFactory<_>>, then root(), to compute from scratch hashed state. This independent legacy scratch encoding works for both source layouts; do not copy or trust source trie caches or use source incremental_root. Compare against canonical header(E).state_root. Demonstrate the exact pinned API by compiling real v1/v2 fixture consumers as part of implementation.

Check every referenced nonempty account bytecode hash: require the Bytecodes record and hash its original bytecode bytes with keccak256. Audit declared Bytecodes key/content consistency too. Missing or altered code fails even when the account/state root matches. A poisoned derived v1 hashed cache cannot replace authoritative plain rows during calculation.

Default and full EVM validation end at complete actual E; a legitimate complete E>H tail is preserved. Base OCOMP comparisons read immutable canonical JobIntent/finality fields from verified current E and bind referenced B to its retained canonical header. They do not require historical state B or changesets (B,E]. Remove prepare_selected_historical_state, descending rewind scheduling, historical scratch handle lifetimes and related tests from this feature. Pruned historical changesets do not prevent current E validation; required missing headers/frames remain named missing inputs.

Implement read_canonical_block_hash from verified retained headers. The new owner live-job view below is the only new core Rust API; other typed getters already exist. No new ABI selector or storage schema is introduced. Each getter reads the same verified E view; historical block hash/state-root values come from retained headers and immutable job fields, never an E view mislabeled as historical B.

(2) StorageBytes::len() bounds scheduler by LIVE_INDEX_HEADER_LEN + SCHEDULER_ENCODED_LEN*u16::MAX, ready index by READY_INDEX_HEADER_LEN + READY_INDEX_KEY_LEN*MAX_RECORDS_KEPT, response index by RESPONSE_INDEX_HEADER_LEN + RESPONSE_INDEX_KEY_LEN*u16::MAX; checked arithmetic, reuse constants via pub(super).
